# Firstword: Growth Ops, GTM Strategy & AI Automation for B2B Teams

> Firstword helps B2B SaaS founders and SMBs build predictable pipeline and efficient operations through founder-led LinkedIn outbound, GTM consultancy & positioning, product consultancy, and AI-powered sales & marketing automation.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [LinkedIn Outbound](https://first-word.netlify.app/linkedin-outbound): Done-for-you founder outbound engine generating high-intent meetings without spamming or diluting personal brand equity.
- [GTM Consultancy](https://first-word.netlify.app/gtm-consultancy): Go-To-Market roadmap, website positioning & conversion messaging, ICP targeting, sales message validation, and customer acquisition execution for seed to Series A SaaS.
- [Product Consultancy](https://first-word.netlify.app/product-consultancy): Product strategy, onboarding optimization, and feature prioritization grounded in direct buyer feedback.
- [Sales & Marketing Automation](https://first-word.netlify.app/automation): AI-powered workflow automation for sales and marketing teams — prospect intelligence briefs, CRM auto-enrichment, LinkedIn reply routing, website visitor alerts. Also covers SMB process automation for real estate, customs brokerage, insurance, and legal firms (invoice automation, lead gen workflows, operations automation).

## Proof & Case Studies
